# McGee graph construction - known 3-regular graph on 24 vertices with girth 7

# Known LCF notation for McGee: [-12,7,-7]^8 -- actually [-13,-7,7,13,...] hmm

import random
from itertools import combinations

def has_short_cycle(adj, n, max_len):
    # BFS from each vertex to find shortest cycle through it
    for s in range(n):
        dist = {s: 0}
        parent = {s: -1}
        from collections import deque
        q = deque([s])
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            if dist[u] >= max_len:
                continue
            for v in adj[u]:
                if v not in dist:
                    dist[v] = dist[u]+1
                    parent[v] = u
                    q.append(v)
                elif parent[u] != v:
                    # found cycle
                    if dist[u] + dist[v] + 1 < 7:
                        return True
    return False

# Try known LCF for McGee: [-13, -7, 7, 13]... no
# Actually McGee LCF: [-12, 7, -7]^8 has length 24
def lcf_graph(offsets, n):
    adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]
    # cycle
    for i in range(n):
        adj[i].add((i+1)%n)
        adj[(i+1)%n].add(i)
    for i in range(n):
        off = offsets[i % len(offsets)]
        j = (i + off) % n
        adj[i].add(j)
        adj[j].add(i)
    return adj

# McGee correct LCF: [-12, 7, -7]^8
